title: LearnVector – Andrew Ng's AI company building one‑to‑one learning experiences
summary: LearnVector is Andrew Ng's AI education company focused on creating personalized one-to-one learning experiences at scale, leveraging AI to provide individualized tutoring and educational support that was traditionally only available through human tutors.
problem_solved: Providing scalable personalized education that mimics one-on-one human tutoring through AI technology
why_valuable: democratizes access to quality personalized learning by using AI to scale what was previously only available through expensive private tutors
